thought.text: The `app` prepare script requires Java (openapi-generator-cli). Let me install a JDK.

reasoning_content:
The pnpm install `prepare` script runs openapi-generator-cli which needs Java. So Java is required on the host for the frontend install too. The guide's preflight doesn't check java but the `app` prepare script needs it. Let me install a JDK 25 (backend uses temurin 25, but the openapi generator just needs any java). The devcontainer used gradle-sdkman jdk 21. Let me install openjdk. Ubuntu 22.04 has openjdk-17/21? Let me check apt. Actually the generator just needs java 8+. Let me install default-jdk or openjdk-21.
